snippet.title: ADW: Gacha Date! Trailer OtomeJam 2024 submission
snippet.description:
Full game is now available~!! https://ekkoberry.itch.io/gacha-date
Complete game free to play.

Features:
✿  ~86k words
✿  6 endings (16 achievements)
✿  12 collectable CGs  in gallery
✿  ~ 120+ minutes of gameplay per route

Credits:
Writing, animation, art assist, programming: CoffeedripStudios
Main Art, GUI, programming: Ekkoberry
Art assist, play testing: Raspberrybell
Music main themes: Alphonse
Copy Editor: De'Gloughan

music for trailer is "letx27s-go-together" from pixabay.com contributor
